title: Governance Coin Dao Voting platform
tagline: Vote with or delegate your GovCoin tokens to help protect the integrity of the protocol
description:
On-chain governance refers to Governance(polling) Polls and Executive Votes, which are formalized governance proposals that require on-chain voting. Anyone who owns BSKT(GovCoin), or NFTs tokens can participate in these votes using their wallet.

The NFTs is basically a representation of playing cards and the voting power is defined for each card after each flush and pattern there is a multiplier for the voting power and voting power is also determined by BSKT token or GovCoin a user holds and also the coin staked in staking pool.
how_its_made: Unique voting power based on the NFT token holder identifying the pattern was difficult and managed to solve it by regex
